title: 2.5 Modelling with functions

q.Q1: Q1. The distance a ball rolls down a ramp varies as t². It rolls 2 m in 1 s. Write the model and find the distance after 3 s.

q.Q2: Q2. Journey time t varies inversely with speed v; t = 3 h when v = 80 km/h. Find t when v = 100 km/h.

q.Q3: Q3. Squares of side x are cut from a 30 cm card to make an open box: V = x(30 − 2x)². Use technology to find the maximum volume.

q.Q4: Q4. When x doubles, y is multiplied by 8. State the type of variation.

q.Q5: Q5. The power P of a wind turbine varies as the cube of wind speed v. P = 54 kW when v = 3 m/s. Find P when v = 5 m/s and the speed needed for 500 kW.
